method: Pillow WebP method=6; Lanczos resizing; no crop; mapped original PNGs preferred. Replacements must be smaller and decode successfully. Lossy candidates below 32 dB PSNR retry at higher quality; larger or low-scoring candidates retain the original.
qualityLimit: PSNR is an encoder error gate, not proof of perceptual quality. Representative comparisons are reviewed separately.

limits: No fresh browser pass or full suite.
